# Pilar Compass

> Open-source student tools for Sekolah Pilar Indonesia — competitions, TKA/OSN practice, SIBI textbooks, and a transparent university match %. Fork it onto your own school domain.

## Product
- School: Sekolah Pilar Indonesia (https://sekolah-pilar-indonesia.sch.id/)
- Live: https://pilar-compass.vercel.app
- Repo: https://github.com/JustHackr/pilar-compass
- License: MIT
- Audience: SPI Junior & Senior High (email-domain gate; demo accepts `@pilar.sch.id`)
- Modules: Competitions · TKA · OSN · Materials · University calculator · Admin dashboard

## Docs
- [README](README.md)
- [Usage](docs/USAGE.md)
- [Self-host / own domain](docs/SELF_HOSTING.md)
- [PRD](docs/PRD.md)

## Stack
Next.js 16 (App Router) · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS 4 · optional Postgres · Vercel

## Run locally
```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Demo unlock: `admin@pilar.sch.id` (admin) or `rina.12-rio-de-janeiro@pilar.sch.id` (student).

## Test
```bash
npm test
```

## Deploy
Import the repo on Vercel. Build: `npm run build`. Optional `DATABASE_URL` for shared TKA progress. Custom domain: Vercel → Settings → Domains. School identity: `src/config/school.ts`.

## Honesty notes
- Competition list is public/curated data plus date logic. Refresh: `npm run competitions:scrape`.
- Match % is an illustrative heuristic with visible weights — not official admissions odds.
- Admin homerooms in the demo are seeded sample students.
